ijssel: a river in the central Netherlands flowing north to the IJsselmeer
ijssel river: a river in the central Netherlands flowing north to the IJsselmeer
ijsselmeer: a shallow lake in northwestern Netherlands created in 1932 by building a dam across the entrance to the Zuider Zee
ijtihad: the endeavor of a Moslem scholar to derive a rule of divine law from the Koran and Hadith without relying on the views of other scholars
